purpose: Resolve the completion audit's omitted deadline measurements and normal/stress coverage without changing the original primary metric, weights or retained data.
primary: Original reference suite: four equally weighted pre/post-Azul transfer/storage workloads, 1024 user transactions, 1s blocks, 100M gas limit, two warm-up and ten measured blocks; at least five alternating pairs and >=15% reduction with >=15% lower 95% confidence bound remain mandatory.

deadline_definitions.payload_job_deadline_misses: Direct production counter incremented when BlockPayloadJob::poll reaches PayloadJobDeadline (attributes timestamp plus configured availability leeway). Record counter deltas separately for builder and verification windows; zero expirations permitted.
deadline_definitions.missing_flashblocks: Direct production missing_flashblocks_count histogram sum delta for the successful build; zero missed scheduled flashblocks permitted.
deadline_definitions.reduced_flashblocks: Direct production reduced_flashblocks_number histogram sum delta from late attributes; zero reductions permitted in controlled runs.
deadline_definitions.build_wall_budget: Conservative processing budget: configured builder block_time plus block_time_leeway, 1.5s for reference/stress and 2.5s for normal. Reject any block exceeding this budget; zero tolerance. This is stricter than a future attributes timestamp plus leeway and complements, rather than replaces, the direct production deadline counter.
deadline_definitions.tolerance: Zero observed misses for either binary in every scenario; no absent deadline evidence accepted. Existing 5% p95 latency and RSS noise guardrails remain unchanged.

representativeness.reference_source: Base mainnet archive RPC; immutable hashes for blocks 52240170 through 52240185, read on 2026-10-06, in target/pipeline-profile/mainnet-traffic-reference.json. Observed two-second cadence, 400M gas limit, roughly 123-237 transactions and 20.5-60.2M gas per block. This characterizes load levels, not a mainnet-state replay.
representativeness.normal: 160 transactions per block, 16 deterministic senders, two-second cadence, 400M gas limit, ten arrival batches spread over 1.4s. Storage calls write eight fresh slots, giving about 32M gas/block and matching the sampled normal count/gas regime. Simple transfers cover the lower-compute traffic path. Both transaction classes are tested before and after Azul.
representativeness.stress: 2400 simple transfers or 2048 one-fresh-slot storage calls per block, one-second cadence, 100M gas limit. Transfers exercise about 96% of the Jovian DA-footprint budget; storage exercises about 88% of execution gas capacity. The preliminary 4096-transfer smoke test hit the protocol DA cap at 2500 inclusions and is retained as rejected fixture-design evidence, not an accepted performance run. No limit is disabled or raised, and all newly declared legal work must be included. Both forks are tested.
representativeness.limitations: Synthetic production-code-path fixtures with measured mainnet load-shape rationale; not transaction/state replay. Coverage includes distinct arrival patterns and near-capacity gas-budget stress. No production-host/mainnet latency or basic-builder speedup claim.

coverage_sampling: Five alternating independent baseline/candidate pairs for each of eight normal/stress fork/transaction-class cases; two warm-up and ten measured blocks per run. Fresh MDBX genesis state; identical deterministic transaction work and harness for both binaries. Independent validator re-executes actual canonical transaction order.
coverage_acceptance: Complete inclusion, equal gas work, canonical parity, expected fallback+scheduled publication counts, zero direct deadline/frame misses and no p95 active/wall/driver or peak RSS regression above 5% in any coverage scenario. These are safety/representativeness guards; they do not replace or reweight the original >=15% primary performance requirement.
fixture_storage: Use an explicitly configured 64 MiB sparse MDBX maximum for both nodes and both versions; honor NodeConfig.db.max_size in the fixture initializer. This removes the unit fixture's 4 MiB capacity ceiling without disabling persistence. Reject any persistence/termination error or panic in run logs, including shutdown. The exploratory 4 MiB stress run is retained but not accepted evidence.
production_instrumentation: Only add a deadline-expiration counter to the baseline and candidate production code. Timing boundaries remain identical. The strengthened harness and deadline collector must have matching source hashes.
